summary: This configuration forces PDF files to download as attachments instead of opening in the browser. When a user requests a PDF, the server tells their browser to treat it as a generic binary file and present a download dialog rather than attempting to display it.

explanations.1: FilesMatch is a directive that matches files by their filename pattern; the regex here says 'any file ending in .pdf'
explanations.2: ForceType tells the server to send this file with a specific MIME type (application/octet-stream is a generic 'binary blob' type that browsers don't know how to display)
explanations.3: Header set Content-Disposition attachment instructs the browser to treat this as a file to download and save, rather than a resource to display inline
